content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

This is sovereign commerce infrastructure—a complete digital stack designed to let you sell beats online without relying on restricted payment processors. It’s not a plugin or a patch; it’s a self-owned system. Here’s why it matters: in Kenya, Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, leaving creators like you with no reliable way to collect payments. This infrastructure replaces those platforms entirely. You host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, handle backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. Once payment confirms on-chain, the system automatically delivers your beats via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You own every component, and COREMERCH has no access after deployment. This isn’t just a workaround—it’s a permanent solution built for creators who need to operate independently.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is modular and straightforward. First, your store is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. The backend logic, which handles order processing and file delivery, runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools are serverless, meaning they scale automatically without additional cost. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your stack choice. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which integrates directly into your store. When a buyer sends crypto, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and triggers a webhook. This webhook signals the backend to deliver the beats instantly via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The entire process is automated, secure, and transparent. You set the price in USD, and NOWPayments converts it to the buyer’s chosen cryptocurrency at the time of purchase. There’s no need for manual intervention—the system handles everything from payment to delivery.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is built for digital creators in Kenya and similar regions who sell beats, ebooks, courses, or other digital products but are locked out of conventional payment processors. If you’ve ever had a sale fail because Stripe or PayPal isn’t available, this is for you. It’s also for creators who want full ownership of their commerce infrastructure. With this stack, you’re not renting tools—you’re owning them. There are no subscriptions, no recurring fees, and no platform dependencies. Once deployed, the system is yours to operate and modify as needed. It’s designed to withstand payment rejections, currency instability, and financial isolation—challenges that creators in Kenya face daily. This isn’t a temporary fix; it’s a long-term solution for creators who need to build on solid ground.
Own your commerce infrastructure—no platform dependencies.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides hosting, ensuring your store is always online and fast. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic, from order processing to file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data securely. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers your beats instantly after payment confirmation. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration. For example, Cloudflare Workers is serverless and globally distributed, ensuring low latency for buyers worldwide. NOWPayments requires no KYC, making it accessible to both you and your buyers. Together, these tools form a robust, self-owned commerce stack that operates independently of restricted platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this system, start by choosing your stack: the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Both are deployed within 48 hours and come with 30-day support. If you prefer to build it yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for instant download. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started. Once deployed, load your beats into the system, set your prices in USD, and share your store link with buyers. The system handles the rest—from payment processing to file delivery. You’ll receive payments directly in your crypto wallet, with no intermediaries. This isn’t just a technical solution; it’s a way to reclaim control over your business. Deploy today and start selling beats globally, on your terms.

Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to purchase. 3. Load your beats into the system and set prices in USD. 4. Share your store link with buyers and start accepting crypto payments. 5. Monitor transactions via NOWPayments dashboard and track orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Use the included 30-day support to resolve any issues during deployment.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are deployed for you within 48 hours. If you choose the Complete Builder Kit, the blueprints and templates are designed to be followable even if you’re not a developer.
What cryptocurrencies can my buyers use?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. The system uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Google Sheets. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction charge.
What happens if a payment fails?
NOWPayments automatically retries failed transactions. If the payment still doesn’t confirm, the system won’t deliver the beats, ensuring you’re protected.
Can I modify the system after deployment?
Yes. You own the entire stack and can modify it as needed. The Complete Builder Kit includes full source code for customization.
